A Researcher with twelve years of experience in observational oceanography, possessing strong computational, experimental, and remote sensing skills, and specializing in phytoplankton biophysical interactions using in-situ and satellite observations. Seeking marine scientist or environmental management roles in transdisciplinary research related to climate change and marine ecology
